Students who see the advantages being active gives them, often look for more things to do and challenge themselves to be successful. Those people who are not as active need motivation and encouragement, and they can easily obtain that from friends or classmates who are active all the time. People who are active are willing to do many things, and one of their accomplishments can be help others to feel the same way they feel by doing all these goood things. Being an example of a healthy life to others can be helpful for those who need it, because they see how good their life can be and the disadvantages or consequences they can have in their future. Helping others is beneficial for both sides, active students and inactive students who are willing to set goals and achieve many more things.

In conclusion, people can accomplish many more things when they are doing something than when they are not doing anything because they tend to get better grades, it helps them build a good behavior for their future life, and it encourages them to help others who are not as active as them. All these reasons are a good way to see how teen's effort affects their future and health, but there is always a bad side. Being active all the time can also have its disadvantages; inactivity can be more relaxing, less stressing and even fun. Eventhough all these reasons are good, being active will be always have more advantages and will always the best choice if people want to be healthy, successful and happy in their future life.
